Menu.Name: LucD20 Automations
Menu.Label: Open LucD20 Automations
Menu.Hint: Every LucD20 feature and its options, organized by category.

Hub.Title: LucD20 Automations
Hub.Enable: Turn this feature on or off
Hub.Reset: Reset this feature's options to their defaults
Hub.ResetContent: Reset all options of {name} to their defaults? Its on/off switch is not changed.
Hub.ReloadContent: Some changes only take effect after a reload. Reload now?
Hub.ScopeWorld: World: set by the GM for everyone
Hub.ScopeClient: Per player: each user has their own value
Hub.LegendClient: Per player (each user sets their own)

Error.FeatureStart: LucD20 Automations: {name} failed to start. See the console (F12) for details.
Error.NoGM: This needs a GM to be connected.

combat.Label: Combat
combat.Hint: Turn markers, turn announcements and post-combat loot.

chat.Label: Chat
chat.Hint: Pinned messages and the damage log.

tokens.Label: Tokens & Placement
tokens.Hint: Editing several tokens at once and placing actors on the map.

vision.Label: GM Vision
vision.Hint: How the map looks to the GM.

sheets.Label: Sheets & Windows
sheets.Hint: Actor sheets and window title bars.

playerSettings.Label: Player Settings
playerSettings.Hint: Defaults and locks for players' own settings, for any module.

exploration.Label: Exploration
exploration.Hint: PF2e Search automation and hazard detection.

turnMarker.Name: Turn Marker
turnMarker.Hint: A rotating marker under the token whose turn it is. Its size follows the token's size.

nextTurnMarker.Name: Next-Turn Marker
nextTurnMarker.Hint: A marker on the combatant who acts next. Skips defeated combatants and is never shown on tokens players can't see.

turnAnnouncer.Name: Turn Announcer
turnAnnouncer.Hint: A chat card at each turn with the token image, name and player. Hidden combatants are skipped. Players get a heads-up when they're up next.

lootPile.Name: Loot Pile
lootPile.Hint: After combat, review the dead NPCs' gear and drop it as one loot pile. Players take items or send them to the Party Stash.

chatPins.Name: Chat Pins
chatPins.Hint: The GM can pin chat messages. Pinned messages survive Clear Chat and are listed in a Pins view.

damageLog.Name: Damage Log
damageLog.Hint: A separate log of every HP change and its cause. Players only see tokens whose HP bar they can see.

multiTokenEdit.Name: Multi-Token Edit
multiTokenEdit.Hint: Edit several selected tokens at once from the token right-click menu. Only the fields you change are applied.

folderDrop.Name: Folder Drop
folderDrop.Hint: Drop an actor folder (or a PF2e party) on the map and place every actor at once, randomly or one by one.

gmVision.Name: GM Vision Mode
gmVision.Hint: Selecting a token keeps the whole map visible, with darkness dimmed. Ctrl+G switches to real token vision.

outOfSightOutlines.Name: Out-of-Sight Outlines
outOfSightOutlines.Hint: Tokens that no player can see are drawn with a dashed outline.

cleanTitleBars.Name: Clean Title Bars
cleanTitleBars.Hint: In every window, title-bar buttons show only their icon; hover for the name. The window title stays.

diceStats.Name: Dice Stats
diceStats.Hint: Roll statistics for everyone, all-time and per session. In PF2e also by roll type and degree of success.

forceSettings.Name: Force Player Settings
forceSettings.Hint: Set a default or lock any per-player setting (ours, other modules', Foundry's own) for all players. Use the lock button next to a per-player setting, here or in Foundry's Configure Settings. GMs are never affected.

searchAutomation.Name: Search Automation
searchAutomation.Hint: Characters Searching in exploration automatically roll secret Perception checks against hidden things in Search regions.

hazardDetection.Name: Hazard Detection
hazardDetection.Hint: Hazards notice Searching characters within a range that walls block, then trigger secret checks.

headerButtons.Name: Always Show Header Buttons
headerButtons.Hint: Moves chosen items from a window's ⋮ menu into its title bar as icons, and adds Configure Ownership to older-style sheets.

extras.Name: Other ⋮ items
extras.Hint: Names of other ⋮ menu items to show in the title bar, separated by commas. Example: 3D Dice Settings, View Token Artwork

ForceSettings.Empty: No forced settings yet. Click the lock button next to any per-player setting, here or in Foundry's Configure Settings.

Tooltip.none: Not forced. Click to force this for players.
Tooltip.default: Default for players (they can change it). Click to edit.
Tooltip.lock: Locked for players. Click to edit.

default.Label: Default
default.Hint: Applied once to every player; they can change it afterwards.

lock.Label: Locked
lock.Hint: Always your value; players see it greyed out and can't change it.
